alex.k: FYI my dep-bump PR merged and main turned red right after. smoke-gpu step failing consistently.
ci-bot: Pipeline failed (main): smoke-gpu · exit code 2 · https://ci.redwood.com/builds/12345
mira: can someone grab logs? quick glance shows allocator_test OOM in shard-3
jordan: I see repeated KVAlloc OOM stack in the log: `gpu/allocator.cc:422` — pasting snippet below
```
E tensorflow: allocator.cc:422 allocate failed: out of memory
Stack: kvalloc::alloc -> gpu::Allocator::alloc -> test::AllocatorTest::Run
```
alex.k: rollback? the PR was just a protobuf upgrade. unsure if it's the cause.
samuel: let's try a rerun of the affected smoke shard first — I'm kicking a retry: https://ci.redwood.com/retry/12345
ci-bot: Retry started: build 12345-rerun1 · user samuel
samuel: rerun finished — still failing, same OOM
mira: ok starting bisect on main between last-green and HEAD. bisect job: https://ci.redwood.com/bisect/6789
ci-bot: Bisect started by mira · job 6789
mira: bisect reports suspect commit: `abcdef123` by deps-bot — looks like the protobuf bump commit
jordan: hypothesis: protobuf size/layout change increased peak tensor allocation. I'll reproduce locally and check allocator footprints
alex.k: opened revert PR just in case: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/54321 (revert deps bump)
samuel: thanks — I can prototype a quick allocator guard in runtime if revert takes time. assigning tasks: @samuel hotfix, @jordan deep debug
mira: if revert merges and CI green, we can re-run matrix in a feature branch and add a stress test for the protobuf variant
alex.k: noted. appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Pipeline status: waiting on rerun + revert
